item.title: Consolidate 6 separate jq calls in cmd_diagnose into one
item.intent: cmd_diagnose makes 6 separate jq -r calls on the same JSON file to extract individual fields. Combine into a single jq invocation to reduce forks and lines.
steps: Replace the 6 individual jq -r calls in cmd_diagnose with a single jq call that extracts all fields at once
acceptanceCriteria: cmd_diagnose has at most 1 jq call to extract fields from the diagnostics file
